description: Plan 9.10 / X-MB3 acceptance: a UR5-like six-axis arm on the M3 spatial multibond mechanics. GroundSpatial -> Mount -> six Revolute3D joints (axis = local z, kt = kr = 1e7, 0.7-critical damping on the held directions) joined by FixedTransform3DNeutral standard-DH offsets, RigidBody3D links (J-MB10 masses and inertias). Drives: MSe torque sources from the 1 ms ArmPD6 firmware (quintic reference from home to target over 0.8 s starting at 0.1 s, PD, gravity feedforward from the same geometry, torque limits). TCP pose from the ComposePose3D chain plus a 0.1823 m tool offset. Checks: settled joint angles, TCP against the analytic forward kinematics, settled gravity torques, torque limits, tracking errors and diagnostics. X5.3 (plan 9.8, DEC-M5-2) adds the RRR equation-block arm: models rrr (motor driven), rrr-free (energy conservation), rrr-torque (ideal torque sources) and the multibond counterparts rrr-multibond, -soft and -stiff, and the compare entries that compare q1..q3 between them.
